news.title: SpaceX IPO is a ‘referendum’ on Musk, say market watchers
news.detail: Friday's hotly anticipated SpaceX market debut could prove a defining moment for capital markets — and serve as a "referendum" on Elon Musk's leadership.

insight.what: SpaceX IPO被视为对马斯克信任投票
insight.assets: 📈 SpaceX 利好, 📉 特斯拉 承压
insight.chain: 若IPO成功，马斯克专注度或被分散（注意力溢价），特斯拉估值可能承压；失败则市场看空其领导力
insight.watch: SpaceX IPO定价与认购倍数，马斯克特斯拉持股变动

news.title: SpaceX IPO won’t ‘break’ the bull market. But investors are worried about what comes next
news.detail: As far as Wall Street is concerned, the stock market has what it takes to absorb the new supply.

insight.what: SpaceX IPO不会终结牛市，但投资者担忧后续
insight.assets: 📈 美股大盘 中性, 📉 科技成长股 承压
insight.chain: 大型IPO抽走流动性（资金从存量股流向新股），短期压制科技股；但若经济强劲则影响有限
insight.watch: IPO后资金流向（ETF vs 个股），美联储政策预期

news.title: Oracle beats on earnings, but stock drops on plans to raise another $20 billion
news.detail: Oracle topped quarterly expectations, but free cash flow is negative, and the company plans to raise more capital for data center projects.

insight.what: 甲骨文财报超预期，但盘后跌4%因再融资200亿美元
insight.assets: 📉 甲骨文(ORCL) 利空, 📈 科技债 利好
insight.chain: 增发稀释每股收益（EPS被摊薄），投资者担心估值压力；债市需求增加可能推高科技债收益率
insight.watch: 甲骨文融资用途（并购/回购），云业务营收增速

news.title: 通胀再度升温 特朗普新任美联储主席或很快被迫加息
news.detail: 唐纳德・特朗普总统任命的新任美联储主席凯文・沃什，此前曾主张美联储存在降息空间——这一立场令他深得总统青睐，而特朗普长期将降息视为首要政策目标。

insight.what: 通胀回升，特朗普新美联储主席或被迫加息
insight.assets: 📉 美债 利空, 📉 美股 承压, 📈 美元 利好
insight.chain: 加息预期推高实际利率（名义利率减通胀），压制风险资产；新兴市场资本外流压力加大
insight.watch: 核心PCE（个人消费支出物价指数）月率，美联储官员讲话

news.title: 韩国交易所理事长：韩国股市暴跌并非外资看空该国
news.detail: 核心要点韩国交易所理事长郑恩甫表示，外资抛售韩国股票，并非对韩国市场丧失信心。他在 CNBC 采访中称，韩国市场剧烈波动源于伊朗冲突...

insight.what: 韩国交易所理事长：暴跌非外资看空，或为技术性调整
insight.assets: 📉 韩国KOSPI 中性, 📈 韩元 利好
insight.chain: 若外资未大规模流出，抛售可能来自本土杠杆资金（融资盘爆仓），短期流动性风险可控
insight.watch: 韩国散户杠杆率（信用交易余额），外资每日净买卖数据

news.title: Bezos opens up about AI startup Prometheus after $12 billion raise: 'We're not being secretive'
news.detail: Prometheus is Jeff Bezos' AI startup that launched in November with $6.2 billion in funding. Vik Bajaj is his co-CEO.

insight.what: 贝索斯透露AI初创Prometheus融资120亿美元
insight.assets: 📈 AI板块 利好, 📈 亚马逊 利好
insight.chain: 大额融资显示AI资本开支（资本支出）加速，利好芯片和云服务；亚马逊AI布局强化，估值或获溢价
insight.watch: Prometheus产品落地时间线，亚马逊AI相关营收占比

news.title: 查诺斯警告SpaceX估值过高，称其为“希望与梦想IPO”
news.detail: 知名做空投资者吉姆·查诺斯周三对SpaceX即将进行的首次公开募股发出严厉警告，称这家太空探索公司高达1.75万亿美元的估值建立在“希望与梦想”之上，缺乏基本面支撑。

news.title: Trump might 'love the inflation,' but consumers are feeling the pain, experts say
news.detail: For consumers, the Middle East conflict's impact on the cost of everyday goods has made it harder to make ends meet.

news.title: Supreme Court rules against private suits brought under key securities law
news.detail: The Supreme Court sided with a group of investment funds affiliated with BlackRock and other asset managers to fend off lawsuits brought by private plaintiffs.

news.title: Here are the odds of bear markets in each stock index this summer
news.detail: For the S&P 500, a technical bear market decline of 20% from the closing high of 7,610 would mean a slide to 6,088.
